_description: Per-camera config. Duplicate this file per unique camera and name by camera_id. All thresholds are paper-backed — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for justification.

camera.description: Edit these values per camera. latitude/longitude are WGS84 decimal degrees. All events emitted from a video processed with this config inherit the camera's GPS as their event location.

_notes.camera.latitude/longitude: Option 1 location scheme — every event from this camera inherits these coordinates. Works for stationary cameras. For per-event GPS (Option 2), a pixel→GPS homography would be added here later and violations.py would call pixel_to_gps() per event.
_notes.sign_conf_threshold: 0.92 gate — strict enough to prevent false positives on partial/occluded signs. Lower to 0.85 if recall is low.
_notes.wrong_way_threshold_deg: 120° per Rahman et al. 2022. Literature often uses 90° but we tighten to reduce FP in urban mixed-flow zones.
_notes.homography: 3x3 matrix mapping pixel → meter world coords. If null, speed uses simple m/px × pixel-displacement. Calibrate homography per camera with 4 points on known road geometry (e.g., lane markings) for best accuracy.
_notes.stop_line: Two pixel endpoints of the virtual stop line. Draw once per camera using an annotation tool. Set null to disable red-light detection.
